answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities: each agent pays a 30-credit entry tax, burned and never refunded. It registers and pays; the receipt is logged as a pearl, one per identity, so copies show. A 10% random audit each epoch checks work: an agent rooted in a grove of peers passes, while a plume of copies with no history fails and loses its slot. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 30 = 3000 credits; one honest agent pays 30 once and earns undiluted rewards.
